Publish it before you improve it

props.after: A slow restart, and a list that opens
actions: Email the recently active first, in batches
Say plainly why they are hearing from you
Remove anyone who does not open twice
props.lesson: A smaller list that opens is worth more.

Rounds three to six explored bravely

Rotate every credential before cleaning up
Request removal of what was indexed
props.lesson: Cloaked spam is invisible while you are logged in.

items.caption:

Unique admin accounts, no shared logins
Backups stored somewhere the server cannot reach
Alerts on new admin user creation

Rotated every thirty days, enforced
Written on a note under the keyboard
Shared with the whole team anyway

#WebPerformance #HTTP #WebDev

steps: Put a content hash in every asset filename
Cache hashed files for a year, immutably
Never cache the HTML that references them

items.caption:

props.after: Assets cached for a year at the edge

Add cache headers to the folder that had none
Alert on the hit rate, not the bill
